as_of: Asia-Pacific open Mon Sep 7 (US closed for Labor Day)

dow_jones.note: Sep 4 (Fri) close 53,414.25, -0.51%; hot Aug jobs report lifted rate-hike odds and pressured stocks intraday, but pared losses late. US markets CLOSED Mon Sep 7 for Labor Day.

sp500.note: Sep 4 close ~7,718.60, -0.37%; trimmed earlier losses as mega-cap tech firmed late in session; AI/tech names supported. Next trade Tue Sep 8.

nasdaq.note: Sep 4 close 26,506.99, -0.29%; tech shares actually advanced/firmed into the close, underpinning Asian gains Monday. Nvidia-led AI names steadier after prior week's DeepSeek/AI rout.

us_markets.note: US stocks net down Friday after blowout 162k August jobs report raised Fed hike bets, but tech closed firm. Market shut Mon for Labor Day; futures-led tone heading into Asia/Europe.

hang_seng.note: Asia-Pacific opened higher Monday as investors assessed renewed Middle East hostilities; US tech gains Friday lent support. HK in positive-open camp.

hong_kong.note: Asia risk tone constructive at open: +US tech Friday, oil spiking on US-Iran tanker strikes in Strait of Hormuz watched closely for inflation/margin pressure.

btc.note: Risk appetite firm as Asia opens higher; crypto tracking broader tech-led rebound, mean-reversion from prior risk-off.

eth.note: ETHBTC rangebound; follow-through dependent on tech sentiment and oil-driven macro risk.

macro.treasury_10y: Treasury sell-off piles pressure on weakest US borrowers; yields elevated as hot jobs data reinforces hawkish Fed, lifting funding costs for the most leveraged credits.
macro.oil_hormuz: CRITICAL: US and Iran traded tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz over the weekend; US struck three Iranian oil tankers in response to attacks on warships. Brent climbing toward $96.
macro.oil_prices: CRITICAL: Oil near $96, rising on renewed US-Iran tanker hostilities + Hormuz supply risk; energy-driven inflation worries persist and keep rate-hike speculation alive.
macro.august_jobs: Nonfarm payrolls surged +162,000 in August, unemployment steady at 4.1%; blowout print lifts Fed rate-hike odds — Wall Street debating whether the Fed will need to hike again.
macro.fed_policy: Hawkish bias reasserting: strong jobs + oil-driven inflation push 'will they hike?' debate; bonds under pressure, curve munis/weak credits squeezed.
macro.commodities: Gold/silver pressured by firm dollar and high yields; energy complex bid on Gulf hostilities; risk of stagflationary squeeze on consumer/margins.
macro.ai_disruption: WATCH: DeepSeek AI rout from prior week faded — tech firmed Friday, supporting global reopen. US AI giants seen resilient long-run; volatility on capex-spending questions persists.
macro.september_watch: US CLOSED Labor Day Mon. Asia higher at open. Focus: US-Iran Hormuz escalation, oil ~$96, hawkish Fed after hot jobs. Corporate/proxy scrutiny and treasury pressure on weak borrowers in view.
